name: lordgen-handover-generator
description: LordGen client-document generator (LORDGEN_HANDOVER_GENERATOR_BUILD.md) plus the live site's serverless PDF renderer (website/api/render-pdf.js). Schema validation, gates, section builders, and HTML template are dependency-free by design; Playwright/Chromium is the one thing genuinely needed for watermark-free HTML->PDF rendering, both locally (tools/render_pdf.js, full `playwright`) and on Vercel (website/api/render-pdf.js, `playwright-core` + `@sparticuz/chromium`'s serverless-packaged Chromium binary, since Vercel functions ship no browser and full `playwright`'s bundled browser download is too large for serverless deploy limits).
